observations.behavior: Adds four new configuration parameters and a startup validation rule to the resolution service configuration.
observations.code_quote: All four symbol set parse settings must be positive integers. Invalid values prevent the service from starting.
observations.posthog_connection: These parameters could control memory and concurrency behavior of symbol resolution, potentially affecting stability and resource usage. The README does not establish that the implementation and tests are complete.

observations.behavior: Adds a new metric histogram for symbol set parse input bytes.
observations.code_quote: - **Symbol set parse sizes**: `cymbal_symbol_set_parse_input_bytes{kind}` records known sizes before parsing, including decompressed sizes for supported symbol data. Use its byte-sized buckets to inspect the distribution without relying on per-parse logs. Unknown sizes do not enter this histogram. Logs before parsing still identify fetched blobs of at least 10 MB and known parse inputs of at least 50 MB. These sizes do not measure peak memory.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a metric for inspecting symbol set parse input sizes. This could help diagnose memory or parsing behavior. The README does not establish that the implementation and tests are complete.
